recoverySweepHardening.discoveryQuery: SELECT b.bet_id, b.match_id, b.market_id, ... FROM bets WHERE status IN ('ACCEPTED', 'PENDING', 'OPEN')
recoverySweepHardening.microMarketHandling: Evaluates fallback snapshot tables (match_over_snapshots, match_dismissal_snapshots) when live match row is missing or stale.
recoverySweepHardening.macroMarketHandling: Strictly preserves STALE_DATA block for full-match markets when event finality is unconfirmed.
recoverySweepHardening.safetyGuarantee: Never forces settlement based on age alone.
